description:
Electric Road Bike
The DJ Road Bike is one of the lightest weight ebike (38 lb) built to last with high-quality components and comes equipped with a belt drive for a great ride.
This electric road bike from DJ Bikes Canada is powered by a motor and features 3 levels of pedal assist that puts the power right in your pedal stroke, and the easy-to-access thumb throttle provides power on-demand. The long-lasting 36V Samsung battery can be dismounted and charged anywhere on the go. The charger has a safety design to prevent over-charged.
The DJ Road Bike is designed in Canada to be affordable, powerful and tons of fun. Whether you are a commuter, casual rider or sports fan, this electric road bike is built for everyone.
